{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research Intensity", "construction": "Research and development expenses divided by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high research intensity may be more likely to innovate and experience future growth, but may also be riskier due to the uncertainty of their investments.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Efficiency", "construction": "Advertising expenses divided by sales growth, measured over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high advertising efficiency may be better at converting their marketing efforts into sales, and thus may experience higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Funding Ratio", "construction": "Pension assets divided by pension liabilities, measured at the end of the previous fiscal year", "rationale": "Firms with underfunded pension plans may face future cash outflows to meet their pension obligations, which could reduce their future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director Ownership Concentration", "construction": "The percentage of shares owned by the board of directors, measured at the end of the previous fiscal year", "rationale": "Firms with high director ownership concentration may have more aligned incentives between management and shareholders, leading to better future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Turnover Rate", "construction": "The rate of employee turnover, measured over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high employee turnover rates may experience disruptions to their operations and potentially lower future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supplier Concentration", "construction": "The percentage of cost of goods sold accounted for by the top 5 suppliers, measured at the end of the previous fiscal year", "rationale": "Firms with high supplier concentration may face risks related to supply chain disruptions and potential price increases, which could reduce their future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "The ratio of environmental liabilities to total assets, measured at the end of the previous fiscal year", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face future cash outflows to meet their environmental obligations, which could reduce their future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Unionization Rate", "construction": "The percentage of employees that are unionized, measured at the end of the previous fiscal year", "rationale": "Firms with high unionization rates may face higher labor costs and potentially lower future returns due to the constraints imposed by collective bargaining agreements.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "R&D Collaboration", "construction": "The number of R&D collaborations with other firms, universities, or research institutions, measured over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that collaborate on R&D projects may be more likely to innovate and experience future growth, but may also face risks related to the sharing of intellectual property.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Index", "construction": "A composite index based on factors such as board independence, executive compensation, and shareholder rights, measured at the end of the previous fiscal year", "rationale": "Firms with strong corporate governance may have more aligned incentives between management and shareholders, leading to better future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
